description: Document recording details of goods dispatched for delivery including transporter, consignee, vehicle, and dispatch date.
instructions: Extract the delivery challan number, transporter name, consignee details, description of goods, vehicle registration number, date of dispatch, and confirmation of receipt. Ignore any annexure details and signature lines.

fields.name: deliveryChallanNumber
fields.description: Unique identifier of the delivery challan, e.g. DC-2026-0412.

fields.name: transporter
fields.description: Name of the transporter company or individual.

fields.name: consignee
fields.description: Name and location of the consignee receiving the goods.

fields.name: goodsDescription
fields.description: Description of the goods being delivered.

fields.name: vehicleNumber
fields.description: Vehicle registration number used for delivery.

fields.name: dateOfDispatch
fields.description: Date when the goods were dispatched.

fields.name: receivedBy
fields.description: Name or placeholder for the person who received the goods.
